$comment: Hand-maintained fixes and choices applied to game_data.json (which is read-only). Every entry carries its reason; all are listed in the build report.

markAsFluid.Water: Not flagged Fluid in the dataset, but it is a pipe fluid.
markAsFluid.Crude Oil: Not flagged Fluid in the dataset, but it is a pipe fluid.
markAsFluid.Molten Tin: Not flagged Fluid in the dataset, unlike every other molten metal.

excludeMachines.Doggo House: Consumes items and produces nothing the solver can model (random loot).

excludeRecipes.Well Water: Resource Well Extractor draws 0 MW in the dataset (pressurizer power is not attributed), which would make water free; water comes from Water Extractors instead.
excludeRecipes.Copper Egg (Terrarium): Gourmet Meal loop (A74, Charles 2026-10-11): Gourmet Meal is a placeholder for slugs that are not finalized (its own recipe is excluded by the Placeholder rule). Copper and Iron Slugs still come out of Orange and Pink breeding as byproducts. Revisit when the mod ships a new game_data.json.
excludeRecipes.Iron Egg (Terrarium): Gourmet Meal loop (A74, Charles 2026-10-11): Gourmet Meal is a placeholder for slugs that are not finalized (its own recipe is excluded by the Placeholder rule). Copper and Iron Slugs still come out of Orange and Pink breeding as byproducts. Revisit when the mod ships a new game_data.json.
excludeRecipes.Golden Egg (Terrarium): Gourmet Meal loop (A74, Charles 2026-10-11): Gourmet Meal is a placeholder for slugs that are not finalized (its own recipe is excluded by the Placeholder rule). Copper and Iron Slugs still come out of Orange and Pink breeding as byproducts. Revisit when the mod ships a new game_data.json.
excludeRecipes.Copper Slug (Breeding): Gourmet Meal loop (A74, Charles 2026-10-11): Gourmet Meal is a placeholder for slugs that are not finalized (its own recipe is excluded by the Placeholder rule). Copper and Iron Slugs still come out of Orange and Pink breeding as byproducts. Revisit when the mod ships a new game_data.json.
excludeRecipes.Iron Slug (Breeding): Gourmet Meal loop (A74, Charles 2026-10-11): Gourmet Meal is a placeholder for slugs that are not finalized (its own recipe is excluded by the Placeholder rule). Copper and Iron Slugs still come out of Orange and Pink breeding as byproducts. Revisit when the mod ships a new game_data.json.
excludeRecipes.Golden Slug (Breeding): Gourmet Meal loop (A74, Charles 2026-10-11): Gourmet Meal is a placeholder for slugs that are not finalized (its own recipe is excluded by the Placeholder rule). Copper and Iron Slugs still come out of Orange and Pink breeding as byproducts. Revisit when the mod ships a new game_data.json.

ignoredNodeResources.Geyser: Geothermal power is not modeled and no recipe uses geysers.

minerOres.$comment: Recipe-name prefix used by Modular Miner Crusher/Smelter/Fluid rows → node resource (part name in nodes.csv).

routeAmountOverrides.reason: A5: the dataset gives 20 gangue per 45 Sulfur Powder on impure nodes, not the 1/3 ratio the formula gives; the dataset value wins.

Alien Power Augmenter.reason: A12: modeled as its BasePower only; the grid-wide percentage boost is not linear and is ignored.

virtualTargetMachines.Space Elevator: Phase deliveries become a virtual output item so a phase can be picked as a target.

heaterMachines.$comment: A17 (Charles, 2026-10-01): each recipe on these machines splits into a heater side (fuel and heater byproducts such as Flue Gas, Sour Gas or nuclear waste), which always runs at 100% per whole machine, and a boiler side (one pair from boilerPairs), which scales with throughput. A machine with 'Heater' in its name that is not listed here fails the build.
heaterMachines.Solid Biomass Heater Mk.1 (MP): Modular Power heater: fuel and heater byproducts run at 100% per whole machine; only the boiler pair varies (A17).
heaterMachines.Solid Biomass Heater Mk.2 (MP): Modular Power heater: fuel and heater byproducts run at 100% per whole machine; only the boiler pair varies (A17).
heaterMachines.Solid Fuel Heater Mk.1 (MP): Modular Power heater: fuel and heater byproducts run at 100% per whole machine; only the boiler pair varies (A17).
heaterMachines.Solid Fuel Heater Mk.2 (MP): Modular Power heater: fuel and heater byproducts run at 100% per whole machine; only the boiler pair varies (A17).
heaterMachines.Solution Heater Mk.1 (MP): Modular Power heater: fuel and heater byproducts run at 100% per whole machine; only the boiler pair varies (A17).
heaterMachines.Solution Heater Mk.2 (MP): Modular Power heater: fuel and heater byproducts run at 100% per whole machine; only the boiler pair varies (A17).
heaterMachines.Nuclear Heater Mk.1 (MP): Modular Power heater: fuel and heater byproducts run at 100% per whole machine; only the boiler pair varies (A17).
heaterMachines.Nuclear Heater Mk.2 (MP): Modular Power heater: fuel and heater byproducts run at 100% per whole machine; only the boiler pair varies (A17).

boilerPairs.reason: A17: boiler side of steam heaters; every dataset heater makes 2 Steam per Water.
A17: boiler side of slime heaters; every dataset heater energizes slime 1:1.
